title: Targeting Mr. or Mrs. Smith: Modeling and Leveraging Intrahousehold Heterogeneity in Brand Choice Behavior
authors: Hernán A. Bruno; Javier Cebollada; Pradeep K. Chintagunta
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Hierarchical Bayesian brand-choice model with intrahousehold heterogeneity; package is an illustration on simulated data.
design_notes: IntraHousehold_SimulatedData_Estimation.R: simulates shopper-level choices and estimates the hierarchical choice model in rstan. No treatment timing.
data_files_note: No data file; data are simulated inside the script.
data_provenance_note: Script header: 'a simple illustration on how to estimate the intra HH model using simulated data'.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); design taken from the OpenAlex abstract and code. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
